title: Prepending a Reachability Step
statement: Let $A$ be a program, let an oracle and input be fixed, and let $G$ be a predicate on configurations. If $G$ holds at a configuration $a$ and there is a finite run from the one-step successor of $a$ to a configuration $c$ whose configurations before the endpoint all satisfy $G$, then there is a finite run from $a$ to $c$ whose configurations before the endpoint all satisfy $G$.
hypotheses_covered: Reachability from the one-step successor of $a$ to $c$, with $G$ holding at every earlier configuration
